anytime_rule: anytime score = mean of log10(max(error, eps_ref)) at the four milestone FES; paired per-seed comparison a1 vs a0

aob_lane.identity_rule: a0 arms and every zero-relation a1 arm must reproduce the frozen screen receipt bit-identically; positive-relation a1 arms differ by construction (reordered first sweep) and are compared through the preregistered statistics

eps_reference_rule: aob: min positive frozen-screen final error across the five seeds, divided by 10; generator: min positive U1 seed-117 final error across both hosts, divided by 10; frozen before any S1 arm ran

gate_rules.anytime_nontax_per_host: 95% paired bootstrap lower of mean relative anytime diff >= -0.05
gate_rules.coverage_complete: 240 arms (12 aob mapped hosts x 5 seeds x 2 arms + 6 cells x 5 seeds x 2 hosts x 2 arms)
gate_rules.final_nontax_per_host: geometric mean ratio <= 1.05 with 95% paired bootstrap upper <= 1.05
gate_rules.order_trace_rules: a0 never reorders; a1 reorders exactly where leverage exists and never where it is zero
gate_rules.ov0_exact_no_tax: zero-relation a1 arms bit-identical to their a0 arms

head_slot_rule: first block sweep puts the top ceil(0.20*n_blocks) scopes by (-leverage, original_rank) into its head slots; every other slot and every later sweep keeps the frozen baseline order; ctp host granularity: the interleaved coverage call is the first sweep; gcb host granularity: the first gcb-source sweep
leverage_definition: incident relation count per checkpoint block (U1 protocol preregistration)
u1_annex: the U1 per-case reachability table is a mandatory annex of this gate; S1 applies only to the hosts it marks reachable
